meta.name: design-is
meta.description: Audit a design against Dieter Rams' ten "Good design is..." principles, then hand off a /make-plan prompt for one of three outcomes — new design, refine design, or redesign. Use when the user says "audit this design", "design review", "check this UI against Rams", "is this UI good", "critique this design", "design audit", or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 对照迪特·拉姆斯十大原则审核设计并生成改进方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要依据经典设计原则来评估和优化界面设计。
copy.tagline_en: Audit designs against Dieter Rams' ten principles and generate improvement plans
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to evaluate and improve interface designs based on classic design principles.

howto.what: 按 Dieter Rams 十条设计原则审计设计,逐项打 0–3 分并附证据,判定新设计/细化/重设计,产出 /make-plan 交接提示词,存为 DESIGN-IS-日期 文件夹;不写实现代码。
howto.when: 当你说“审计这个设计”“设计评审”“这个界面好不好”等,或要求对设计做批判性评价且希望形成方案时触发;常规代码审查、纯文案修改、尚未出稿的构思不归它管。

say.text: 审计这个设计,按十条原则打分并附证据。
对照 Rams 原则评审这个 UI,再给 /make-plan 提示词。
say.note: 审计完会生成交接提示词

say.text: 这个设计好不好?按 Rams 标准评审并给出方案。
say.note: Claude 会打分、判定并列后续动作

howto.what_en: Audits a design against Dieter Rams' ten principles, scores each 0–3 with evidence, decides NEW/REFINE/REDESIGN, and outputs a /make-plan handoff prompt in DESIGN-IS-<date>/; no implementation code.
howto.when_en: Use when the user says 'audit this design', 'design review', 'is this UI good', or asks for a critique that should lead to a plan; not for code review, copy edits, or pre-design ideation.

say_en.text: Audit this design and score it against the ten principles with evidence.
Review this UI against Rams' principles, then give me a /make-plan prompt.
say_en.note: Generates the handoff prompt after the audit.

say_en.text: Is this UI good? Run the Rams audit and recommend a next step.
say_en.note: Claude scores, decides, and lists next moves.
